title: Use SF Symbols for Camera Control functions

statement.en: Use SF Symbols that clearly represent each Camera Control function.
statement.ja: 各Camera Control functionを明確に表すSF Symbolを使う。

conditions: Treat a control symbol as its behavior, not its current state.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Camera Control experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるCamera Controlの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Match Camera Control availability to camera mode

statement.en: Enable or disable Camera Control options according to the current camera mode.
statement.ja: current camera modeに応じてCamera Control optionをenableまたはdisableにする。

conditions: Disable video-specific controls while taking photos.
Controls can't be added or removed from the overlay at runtime.

title: Consider Camera Control ordering by usage

statement.en: Consider ordering Camera Control options by usage frequency.
statement.ja: usage frequencyに基づくCamera Control optionの並びを検討する。

conditions: Place commonly used controls near the middle and lesser-used controls on either side.
exceptions: The system returns to the last control used when reopening the overlay.
